verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a SaaS payments platform, so the axis applies. The only AI-related evidence is a documentation MCP server that lets agents search and retrieve doc content. That is adjacent tooling for reading the docs, not a way to operate MoonPay's buy, sell or swap functions through natural-language commands, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The documentation includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve content.
